name: mond-compat
subtitle: Experimental iPadOS Mode locator and iOS 27.0.1 diagnostics
description: Unsigned mond compatibility build with read-only MobileGestalt checks and an experimental, validated CacheData locator for iPadOS Mode on iOS 27.0.1. The firmware-specific iPadOS feature is unverified and can bootloop; a compatible App Group is required.

apps.name: mond-compat
apps.subtitle: Experimental iPadOS Mode on 27.0.1
apps.localizedDescription: Adds an opt-in iPadOS Mode locator based on Nugget's CacheData pattern with strict validation, original backup checks, and a separate high-risk confirmation. This feature has not been validated on an actual iPhone 17 / iOS 27.0.1 and may cause boot loops.

versions.localizedDescription: Experimental iOS 27.0.1 iPadOS Mode locator with additional validation and warning.
versions.changelog: Experimental iPadOS Mode fallback for changed CacheData layout, unique candidate and neighboring-marker validation, backup requirement, confirm-before-apply prompt, and diagnostic showing candidate method. Does not claim successful iPadOS Mode on real hardware.
